ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'until he remembers' mean in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the distinction between mere auditory reception and true spiritual remembrance (dhikr) for those possessing taqwa, contrasting Pharaoh's arrogant ignorance with the insight of the believers. It underscores that divine guidance is not merely informational but transformative, serving as a reminder specifically for those who fear God and remain receptive to His signs.
